title: 銀雨の館と鏡像の不在証明
author: 桐谷 暗

en.title: The Mansion of Silver Rain and the Mirror-Image Alibi
en.premise: Hidden within a grand estate is a 'Lost and Found' shop said to appear only on days of torrential rain. On one such stormy night, the master of the house is found dead within its walls. But as the rain ceases, the entrance vanishes completely, leaving behind a perfect locked room. Amidst a mansion adorned with corridors of mirrors and intricate waterways, the challenge begins: to logically unravel the truth behind an impossible crime.

zh.title: 银雨之馆与镜像的不在证明
zh.premise: 一座仅在豪雨之日才会现身的“失物屋”，被隐藏在深邃的馆邸之中。某个暴风雨之夜，宅邸之主被发现死在店内；然而随着雨势停止，通往店内的入口瞬间消失，现场化为绝对的密室。在镜之回廊与复杂水路机关交织的馆邸中，一场旨在揭开“不可能犯罪”真相的逻辑推演就此展开。

prediction_results.question: 悲鳴の正体と、二人が現場で目撃するものとは？
